value.rationale: The radius-two ball concept class is the next natural distance relation after the Hamming-graph radius-one neighborhoods. Its exact dimension is a fundamental complexity invariant for metric range sampling and logical shattering. The all-dimension ceiling of four with the non-monotone small-dimensional jump from 1 to 3 to 4 is not a routine corollary of the distance-one result, and the finite support reduction supplies a reusable obstruction method. The target is an infinite family, not a sporadic parameter or arbitrary search window.
